$comment: Single source of truth for the Zazie Productions cross-property entity graph. Every outbound link, every sameAs value and every co-mention on horror.zazieproductions.com is generated from this file. Do not hand-edit the generated pages - edit this file and run `node tools/build-ecosystem.mjs`.

releases.title: Anesthesia for the Signal Age
releases.note: The most recent record. Clinical title, unclinical sound: signal decay, tape hiss and slow dissonance held just under the threshold of pain.

releases.title: Opaline Lament (Life From The Beyond)
releases.note: A single long lament built from bowed metal and held reverb tails. The closest the catalogue comes to a ghost story told without words.

releases.title: Spectral Ode to Synesthesia
releases.note: Eight minutes and fifty-six seconds of colour-hearing: one continuous piece that maps pitch onto hue and lets the two drift apart.

releases.title: Greetings From Tinsel Time (Super Deluxe Edition)
releases.note: The deluxe expansion of the 2023 record, with the interludes restored and the 2024 remasters folded in.

releases.title: Stutter to stammer (Super Deluxe Edition)
releases.note: The 2019 EP rebuilt. Contains "Cheaper Impressions", the musique concrete homage to Cage that Black Mountain College commissioned when the composer was fourteen.

releases.title: Greetings From Tinsel Time
releases.note: The original release: hollow-sea ballads, carnival organs and one track reportedly abandoned when the session ended in hypothermia.

releases.title: A Long Way To Nowhere
releases.note: Road record. Repetition as dread, with the melody arriving late and leaving early.

releases.title: Vermiform
releases.note: Seven tracks of body horror in instrumental form. Recorded credited across both name variants, which is why the databases disagree.

releases.title: To Halt Space Adrift
releases.note: Eight tracks of cosmic drift: trichromatic phases, echopraxia, and a closing Gainax Ending that refuses to resolve.

releases.title: Miraculously Unhurt
releases.note: Single. The title is the whole joke and the whole horror.

releases.title: Distant Bells For Surgical Minds
releases.note: Six tracks. Neocortex activation, lobotomies, and bells that never get closer - the record that first drew the film work.

releases.title: Anything Can Happen On An Electric Day
releases.note: EP. Bright surface, wrong underneath - the uncanny-valley end of the catalogue.

releases.title: Constrained Capacity
releases.note: Ten tracks written against a hard limit: hyperfixation simulation, a paranormal woodland incident, and a drill-and-plastic-bag variation.

releases.title: Interference Archive 01010101
releases.note: Transmission debris assembled into pieces. The source material for the analogue-horror sound design work.

releases.title: Sellotape (Super Deluxe Edition)
releases.note: Deluxe rebuild of the 2020 debut: Vlad the Impaler, organised chaos, a cryptic epilogue, and the dismal movie scene.

releases.title: Sellotape
releases.note: The first record. Toy harmonicas, warped live sessions and the wooden creaks of a broken floorboard.

releases.title: Stutter to stammer
releases.note: Where it starts. Hundreds of collected sounds - TV static, windscreen wipers, toy instruments - stretched into fragments of classical music that slash out into noise.

releases.title: G7e Torpedo
releases.note: The oldest entry in the Bandcamp discography. Not available to stream everywhere; ask if you need it.
